# QCAE Online Questionnaire

This is a privacy-first static implementation of the Questionnaire of Cognitive and Affective Empathy (QCAE).

## Canonical human interface
- /Questionnaire-of-Cognitive-and-Affective-Empathy-QCAE-online-questionnaire/

## Machine-readable resources
- /Questionnaire-of-Cognitive-and-Affective-Empathy-QCAE-online-questionnaire/data/qcae.v1.json
- /Questionnaire-of-Cognitive-and-Affective-Empathy-QCAE-online-questionnaire/data/qcae.schema.json
- /Questionnaire-of-Cognitive-and-Affective-Empathy-QCAE-online-questionnaire/data/results.schema.json
- /Questionnaire-of-Cognitive-and-Affective-Empathy-QCAE-online-questionnaire/data/ui.json

## Scoring
- Responses are integers 1–4 in ascending agreement order.
- Items 1, 2, 17, and 29 are reverse-scored in the original 31-item form.
- The Portuguese validated variant excludes item 17.
- Raw scores are not diagnoses or normative classifications.

## Privacy
The app has no backend, analytics, cookies, accounts, or remote dependencies. Responses are processed only in the browser.
